h: Zlatan and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding gets underway
p: Rapper Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding is underway, with the singer releasing photos from the ceremony on Saturday. The pictures sent "Zlatan" and "Zanku" into Nigeria's top social media trends. Claims of a ₦2.3 billion wedding and a $1 million ring have not been backed up by any credible or official source.
more: The couple posed in matching red and white outfits with coral beads in the official photos.
Zlatan was earlier reported to have bought his bride a Hermes bag ahead of the wedding.
Big names from the entertainment industry are expected to celebrate with the couple.
alt: Davita Lamai in a red beaded gown and coral crown stands beside Zlatan, seated on a gold throne in white and coral beads
